notes.title: Hello to the conquerors of laser spaces!
notes.content:
"HyperPortals" have entered early access, which means that you can already take a step outside the door of perception!

The early access version has the entire text of the story available in English and Russian. 
We really hope you will also not ignore the stylish neon visual and music.

With the next updates, mini-games will be added that will reveal another dimension of "HyperPortals" for you!
Follow the news!
